summary: Add Data USA public API references
body:
Describe the new page here.

= Data USA aggregate API route checks May 20 =

* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes Root cubes]
* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes/acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5 Poverty cube root]
* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes/acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5/aggregate.jsonrecords?drilldowns=Geography.Geography.State&measures=Poverty%20Population Poverty state aggregate]
* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes/acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5/aggregate.jsonrecords?drilldowns=Geography.State.State&measures=Poverty%20Population Poverty state alt fullname]
* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes/acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5/aggregate.jsonrecords?drilldowns=State&measures=Poverty%20Population Poverty state short]
* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes/acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5/aggregate.jsonrecords?drilldowns=Geography.Geography.State%2CYear.Year.Year&measures=Poverty%20Rate Poverty rate full]
* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes/acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5/aggregate.jsonrecords?drilldowns=Geography.State.State%2CYear.Year.Year%2CPoverty%20Status.Poverty%20Status.Poverty%20Status&measures=Poverty%20Population Poverty status full]
* [https://api.datausa.io/cubes/acs_yg_total_population_5/aggregate.jsonrecords?drilldowns=Geography.State.State%2CYear.Year.Year&measures=Population Control population]

See also ApiReferencesForResearch.
